nodes.description: Address of the current owner stored in the Owned contract; used by the onlyOwner authorization check.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, assigned once in the NarcoDoge constructor.
Public token name string, assigned once in the NarcoDoge constructor.
Public token decimals value, set to 18 in the NarcoDoge constructor.
Total token supply minted to the hard-coded deployer address in the constructor.
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount; written by approve and approveAndCall and consumed by transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address used as the authorization subject (owner check, allowance owner, balance owner).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after allowance state was written, permitting reentrancy.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary user-supplied token contract, gated only by onlyOwner.
Arithmetic subtraction of the transferred amount from balances[msg.sender] through SafeMath.safeSub.
Arithmetic addition of the transferred amount to balances[to] through SafeMath.safeAdd.
Arithmetic subtraction decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom via SafeMath.safeSub.
Pure helper performing overflow-checked addition (require(c >= a)).
Pure helper performing underflow-checked subtraction (require(b <= a)).
Pure helper performing overflow-checked multiplication.
Pure helper performing division guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned constructor that sets owner = msg.sender at deployment.
onlyOwner function staging a new owner in newOwner.
Function requiring msg.sender == newOwner that finalizes ownership transfer and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Token constructor that sets symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and pre-allocates the whole supply to a fixed address.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to an arbitrary recipient.
ERC20 approve writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emitting Approval.
ERC20 transferFrom moving tokens from an arbitrary from address using the caller allowance.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract, enabling reentrancy before/after state is settled.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 token address.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from the untrusted msg.sender.
transferOwnership authorization depends on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before mutating ownership state.
transfer debits the balance keyed by msg.sender.
approve writes the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
transferFrom spends the allowance of msg.sender.
approveAndCall sets allowance for msg.sender and passes it to the callback.
transferOwnership stores the supplied _newOwner into newOwner.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after transfer.
NarcoDoge constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
NarcoDoge constructor initializes the name state variable.
NarcoDoge constructor mints _totalSupply.
NarcoDoge constructor credits the entire supply to a fixed address in balances.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply when computing the supply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
balanceOf indexes balances with the tokenOwner parameter.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance indexes allowed with the spender parameter.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfer credits balances[to] for the recipient parameter.
transfer uses the tokens parameter as the transfer amount.
The tokens parameter flows into the unchecked-in-source subtraction of balances[msg.sender].
The tokens parameter flows into the addition that credits balances[to].
safeSub result is written back into the balances mapping for msg.sender.
safeAdd result is written back into the balances mapping for to.
approve uses the spender parameter as the allowance key.
approve stores the tokens parameter as the allowance value.
transferFrom debits balances[from] using the from parameter.
transferFrom credits balances[to] using the to parameter.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter as the transfer amount.
The tokens parameter flows into the allowance decrement arithmetic.
safeSub result is written back into allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall uses the spender parameter both as allowance key and callback target.
approveAndCall stores the tokens parameter as the allowance value.
approveAndCall forwards the data parameter to the external callback.
approveAndCall writes allowed before invoking the external callback, exposing stale state to reentrancy.
approveAndCall unconditionally transfers control to the external receiveApproval call.
The external receiveApproval invocation can re-enter approveAndCall (or transferFrom) before the caller finishes.
transferAnyERC20Token casts the user-supplied tokenAddress parameter to ERC20Interface.
transferAnyERC20Token passes the tokens parameter to the external transfer call.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract under onlyOwner protection.
transferOwnership compares msg.sender against the owner state variable in the onlyOwner modifier.
acceptOwnership emits and rewrites the owner state variable.
safeAdd assigns the sum into local c and returns it.
safeSub assigns the difference into local c and returns it.
transfer delegates its balance credit to safeAdd.
transfer delegates its balance debit to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates its allowance debit to safeSub.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to be consumed by transfer's balance credit.
The tokens parameter directly drives the arithmetic debit of the sender balance.
The spender parameter only indexes the allowed mapping inside approve.
The tokens parameter only sets the allowance value inside approve.
The from parameter only selects the balance and allowance entry debited by transferFrom.
The to parameter only selects the balance entry credited by transferFrom.
The tokens parameter drives the allowance decrement arithmetic in transferFrom.
The spender parameter is the contract target of the external receiveApproval call.
The tokens parameter only sets the allowance value inside approveAndCall.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external callback invocation.
The tokenAddress parameter is cast into the arbitrary external ERC20 call target.
The tokens parameter is forwarded as the amount of the external ERC20 transfer.
The _newOwner parameter only populates the newOwner state variable.
The tokenOwner parameter only indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The spender parameter only indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Local c is the transient return value of safeAdd and carries no independent state.
Local c is the transient return value of safeSub and carries no independent state.
